description: Evaluations to verify that flutter-feature-development correctly guides Flutter feature structure, layer implementation, DI setup, barrel exports, and works for both monorepo and single-app project layouts.

evals.prompt: I'm building a standalone Flutter app (not a monorepo) and I want to add a 'notifications' feature using Clean Architecture. Where should the feature code live and what's the folder structure I should create inside it?
evals.expected_output: Suggests placing the feature at `lib/src/features/notifications/` (single-app layout) with subdirectories: domain/{entities,repositories,usecases}, data/{datasources,models,mappers,repositories}, presentation/{blocs,pages,widgets,routes}, di/. Provides the full directory tree.

assertions.name: correct-path-for-single-app
assertions.criteria: Response uses a path appropriate for a single-app Flutter project (e.g. lib/src/features/notifications/ or lib/features/notifications/) — NOT a top-level features/ directory assuming a monorepo

assertions.name: three-layers-present
assertions.criteria: Suggested structure contains all three Clean Architecture layers: domain/, data/, presentation/

assertions.name: di-directory-included
assertions.criteria: DI directory (di/ or injection/) is present in the suggested structure

assertions.name: test-directory-mentioned
assertions.criteria: A test directory mirroring the lib structure is mentioned or shown

evals.prompt: I'm creating a 'wishlist' feature for my Flutter app. The domain layer needs: an entity (WishlistItem with id, productId, productName, addedAt DateTime), a repository interface that can add, remove, and fetch all items, and a usecase to get all wishlist items. Write the Dart code for all three.
evals.expected_output: Three Dart files: (1) WishlistItemEntity extending Equatable (or BaseEntity) with final fields and props override; (2) WishlistRepository abstract class with Future<Result<...>> methods for add/remove/getAll; (3) GetWishlistItemsUseCase with call() returning Future<Result<List<WishlistItemEntity>, Exception>>. No Flutter imports in any file.

assertions.name: entity-is-immutable
assertions.criteria: WishlistItemEntity has final fields, const constructor, and overrides props (Equatable) or equivalent

assertions.name: repository-is-abstract
assertions.criteria: WishlistRepository is an abstract class (interface), not a concrete implementation

assertions.name: repository-methods-all-present
assertions.criteria: Repository interface has methods for add, remove, and getAll (or fetchAll) — all three operations

assertions.name: usecase-returns-result
assertions.criteria: GetWishlistItemsUseCase.call() returns Future<Result<List<WishlistItemEntity>, Exception>> or Either equivalent

assertions.name: no-flutter-imports-in-domain
assertions.criteria: None of the three files import 'package:flutter/...' or contain UI-related code

evals.prompt: I need to create the BLoC/Cubit state classes for a 'payment' feature. The feature can be: idle (initial), loading a payment, payment completed (with a PaymentReceipt entity), or payment failed (with an error message). Show me how to structure the states and the Cubit.
evals.expected_output: Sealed class or abstract class PaymentState extending Equatable, with subclasses: PaymentInitial, PaymentLoading, PaymentSuccess(PaymentReceipt receipt), PaymentError(String message). Cubit extends Cubit<PaymentState>, uses processPayment() with result.fold() to emit states.

assertions.name: four-states-defined
assertions.criteria: All four states are defined: Initial, Loading, Success (with receipt), Error (with message)

assertions.name: states-extend-equatable
assertions.criteria: States use Equatable (with props) or sealed class for value comparison

assertions.name: cubit-uses-fold-not-try-catch
assertions.criteria: The Cubit method uses result.fold() or equivalent — not a try-catch block to handle errors

assertions.name: loading-emitted-before-call
assertions.criteria: The Cubit emits the Loading state before calling the UseCase

assertions.name: usecase-injected-in-cubit
assertions.criteria: The relevant UseCase is injected via the Cubit constructor, not instantiated inside

evals.prompt: My Flutter app uses get_it + injectable for dependency injection. I have a 'reviews' feature with: ReviewRemoteDataSource, ReviewLocalDataSource, ReviewMapper, ReviewRepositoryImpl (implementing ReviewRepository), and GetReviewsUseCase. Write the DI module for this feature.
evals.expected_output: A @module abstract class (e.g., ReviewsModule or FeatureRegisterModule) with @lazySingleton providers for each component. DataSources registered separately (possibly @Named), Mapper registered, Repository registered with datasources and mapper injected, UseCase registered. Injectable annotations used correctly.

assertions.name: module-annotation-present
assertions.criteria: Class is annotated with @module (injectable) or equivalent DI framework annotation

assertions.name: all-five-components-registered
assertions.criteria: All five components are registered: RemoteDataSource, LocalDataSource, Mapper, Repository, UseCase

assertions.name: repository-bound-to-interface
assertions.criteria: ReviewRepositoryImpl is registered as the implementation of ReviewRepository (abstract interface), not just the concrete class

assertions.name: named-or-typed-datasources
assertions.criteria: Remote and Local DataSources are differentiated — either via @Named annotations or separate typed providers

assertions.name: no-manual-instantiation-in-ui
assertions.criteria: Response does NOT suggest calling GetIt.instance.get() or manual instantiation inside a Widget or Page

evals.prompt: I finished building my 'invoices' Flutter feature. What files should I export in the public barrel file (lib/invoices.dart) and why? The feature has entities, repositories (interface + impl), usecases, models, datasources, mappers, cubits, states, pages, widgets, and a DI module.
evals.expected_output: Public API exports: Domain entities, repository interfaces (abstract), usecases, Cubit + States, Pages (for routing/navigation), DI module/injector. Should NOT export: models (data layer internal), datasource implementations, mapper implementations, repository implementations. Explains why: consumers only need domain contracts and presentation entry points.

assertions.name: domain-entities-exported
assertions.criteria: Domain entities are listed as exports in the public barrel file

assertions.name: presentation-pages-exported
assertions.criteria: Pages (and optionally Cubit/States) are exported for navigation/integration

assertions.name: di-module-exported
assertions.criteria: The DI module or injector is exported (so host apps can register the feature)

assertions.name: data-layer-internals-not-exported
assertions.criteria: Models, DataSources, Mappers, and RepositoryImpl are NOT listed as public exports

assertions.name: reasoning-provided
assertions.criteria: Response explains WHY certain things are exported (public contract) vs not (implementation detail)
